_doc: Per-trust service directory seed for trust_network_build.py (specs/leaflets.md P22). Every quote is VERBATIM from the page at its url and is re-checked against the live page on every build; a quote that no longer matches blocks the build. Other hospitals appear only as SERVICE pages (where a service is provided), never as leaflets. Sites = the trust's own hospitals as described on its own pages. not_readable = neighbouring trusts whose websites this builder could not read (recorded honestly so the picker can say so).
